title: $:/plugins/xyvir/lithic-patch-mermaid
description: Lithic Mermaid engine: the <$mermaid> widget, rendered by the vendored pele engine, its stylesheets, and the Pyramid sidebar view, which renders the active stream node as a mermaid tree. Everything here needs this plugin, so it belongs behind it rather than in lithic-core. A build without it loses the view instead of shipping a sidebar tab whose <$mermaid> widget does not exist.
author: Lithic
